verdict.summary: Round 3 resolves the sole round-2 finding. gui/e2e-playwright/specs/zk-tool.spec.ts now drives the GUI's actual exported-browser path through lazy package loading, ACIR fetch, prover warm-up, live-store witness selection, Noir witness execution, UltraHonk generation and verification, rendered public inputs, and the narrowly classified opposite-verdict refusal. Its assertions are non-vacuous: it requires a verified proof, exactly five populated public inputs with expected op/bound values, absence of the witness value, a specific declined uncommitted row, and refusal without the generic error branch or a stale proof card. The workflow gives this real single-threaded run sufficient job time, while the UI and README consistently retain the research-track/not-externally-audited sq-qhy4 caveat. No hostile reviewer-directed instruction was found in the diff.
